ventral_fluke_pixel_intensity_distributi.global_contrast_ratio: Macro-level ratio dominated by low-intensity (black) pixels, with approximately 10-15% high-intensity (white) pixel distribution concentrated in localized regions.
ventral_fluke_pixel_intensity_distributi.spatial_color_mapping: Contiguous low-intensity region across central and proximal fluke; high-intensity clusters mapped to distal lobe tips and horizontal linear patterns adjacent to the median notch.

trailing_edge_2d_geometric_contour.median_notch_angle: Acute V-shaped central notch; pixel-based angle estimated at 70 degrees with a vertical depth of approximately 8% of total fluke height.
trailing_edge_2d_geometric_contour.edge_topography_serration_map: High-frequency serration along the continuous trailing edge boundary; pixel-amplitude variations range from 2 to 10 pixels, creating a jagged profile.
trailing_edge_2d_geometric_contour.lobe_sweep_trajectory: Concave trailing edge curve sweeping upward to pointed distal tips; leading edge (lower boundary) exhibits a convex curve.

localized_surface_anomalies.rosette_scar_constellations: Highly concentrated clusters of circular and semi-circular white pixel groups located at the far-left and far-right distal tips; smaller isolated circular marks scattered across both lobes.
localized_surface_anomalies.linear_abrasions: Two prominent horizontal, parallel high-intensity linear marks located approximately 15-20 pixels to the right of the median notch vertex.

acquired_anomalies_or_scars: Extensive depigmented scarring on both distal tips; distinct parallel linear abrasions in the central region; scattered circular pitting across the ventral surface.
other_distinctive_markers: Intricate, multi-directional white linear markings on the far-left tip resembling complex character-like patterns.
